comment.narrative: Twentyfour mayoralties have strengthened their capacities with at least 30 about gender equality womens specific needs and ways for gender mainstreaming according to internal evaluations. In addition 14 partner localities improved their online communication and transparency. 48 mayors accountants and council secretaries from 12 partner communities enhanced their ability to analyze nonfinancial indicators of local budgets found opportunities and reasoning for integrating a GSO perspective a process primarily unknown earlier by the specialists.Training methodology was developed based on the needs identified at the local level and according to the entry points suggested by assessing the local practices on gender mainstreaming. In February 2022 UN Women Moldova partnered with Artemida an experienced NGO in providing services for domestic violence victims to enhance the capacities of two local CSOs in Cahul and Ungheni regions. Artemida facilitated two subpartnerships with local CSOs to improve GBV case management and provide specialist services to victims. In addition Clubul vreau sa stiu signed memorandums with LPAs and Social Assistance Directorate to increase knowledge about specialist services among 162 representatives of MDTs from other communities. UNICEF also partnered with CCF Moldova to strengthen the capacities of foster care parents in supporting child victims of violence including GBV leading to improved services and reintegration of victims. As a result territorial guardianship authorities have also improved their ability to identify and respond to GBV and provide childfriendly accessible services.
